selection_rule: First data row (source_row=1) in each pinned source CSV: workforce, creatives, scientists. Selected before substantive content review.
scope: Three complete interviews; convenience demonstration, not representative or a saturation claim.
question: How do these participants describe AI uses, evaluations, constraints, and desired changes? What do adjacent interviewer turns contribute to interpreting their answers?
authorship: AI-assisted qualitative interpretations authored November 13 and extended November 14, 2026. No independent human ratings or baseline comparison.
publication: Selected short quotations, public source-record locators, transcript hashes, and AI-assisted interpretations. Full transcripts stay local.
review_status: Source quotations, attribution, offsets, and record hashes checked programmatically; interpretation reviewed within the same authoring session, not independently rated.

extensions.qualitative_scope: Same three complete interviews; no semantic reading of additional records.
extensions.numeric_outlier_rule: Participant messages within each cohort; inclusive quartiles; words strictly above Q3 + 1.5 * IQR. Rule recorded before calculation; no exclusions.
extensions.coverage_goal_source: Anthropic research article, Research goals section; publisher goals paraphrased, operational subquestions authored for this example.
